summary: Marcus and Ange discuss the aftermath of a mass arrest of about 800 protesters, whose side the press is not covering. Marcus shows Ange saved blogs, videos and photostreams from people who were gassed and beaten, and Ange proposes compiling everything into one press-facing page linked to Xnet HOWTOs. Marcus then walks off in panic, convinced the DHS knows he is M1k3y and that he is doomed, and Ange chases him down on Market Street as he considers throwing himself in front of a Muni trolley.
one_line: Marcus and Ange argue over why the press ignores the protesters' side after a mass arrest, and Marcus panics that the DHS has identified him as M1k3y.
key_facts: Eight hundred people were arrested as "rioters" and their processing was underway, with no one telling the protesters' side.
Marcus had saved blogs, videos and photostreams to his phone, including first-hand accounts from people who had been gassed and beaten.
The video showed protesters dancing, giving peaceful political speeches, and chanting "Take It Back."
Trudy Doo is shown in the video talking about the protesters being the only generation that could believe in fighting for their freedoms.
Ange argues that the press would benefit from covering the controversy because it would sell more papers and commercials than a simple crime story.
Ange proposes writing everything up in one place with all the links, intended for the press to find, and linking it to the HOWTOs for Xnet.
Ange says Internet users can reach the Xnet, provided they don't care about the DHS finding out what they have been surfing.
When Ange asks why anyone would listen, she answers "Who wouldn't listen to M1k3y?"
Marcus believes that if Ange figured out he is M1k3y, the DHS had too, and he considers himself doomed.
Marcus says the DHS let him go from its truck and that he had expected they would someday arrest him and send him away forever, as they had Darryl.
Ange nearly tackles Marcus on Market Street, is out of breath and furious, and asks what his problem is.
Marcus tells himself that dying under a Muni trolley would be better than going back.
Ange calls Marcus by name and says she is scared, prompting him to stop and look at her.
